about.headline: About Kriya
about.description:
Kriya Biosys Private Limited is a young and dynamic company specialized in the manufacture and export of high-quality organic crop inputs. We are passionate about empowering sustainable agriculture with 100% organic crop protection solutions.

Our purpose is to provide effective, eco-friendly solutions for nutrition management, pest control, and disease management – without harming nature. Our products are designed to meet the challenges faced by modern growers while supporting sustainable farming practices. We focus on delivering solutions that improve crop health, soil vitality, and overall farm productivity. We measure our success not only through business performance but also by the positive impact we bring to agriculture and the environment.
highlights: Specialized in manufacture and export of organic crop inputs
Effective solutions for nutrition, pest control, and disease management
Improve crop health, soil vitality, and farm productivity
Positive impact on agriculture and environment

Equipped with advanced technology and modern processing systems, our facility ensures consistent quality, efficiency, and scalability to serve customers across international markets.

From the careful sourcing of high-quality raw materials to the final packaging and dispatch of finished products, every stage of our manufacturing process is governed by strict quality control protocols. Strategically located and supported by robust logistics capabilities, our manufacturing operations enable us to deliver reliable and sustainable agricultural inputs to farmers and partners worldwide.

techContent.16: BioDesk presents Kriya as a technology-led agricultural biology company. Our platform stack is designed to discover, build, protect, deliver, and activate biological performance across microbial and botanical systems. Wynn powers microbial science and process development. Karyo powers delivery and protection of microbial and botanical actives. Microvate powers precision activation for microbial systems that are designed to become functionally ready only at the point of use.

techContent.51: Each platform in the Kriya technology stack has a distinct role. Wynn is the upstream microbial science engine. Karyo is the active delivery and protection engine. Microvate is the biological readiness engine. Together, they create a clear innovation architecture for next-generation crop input systems.

techContent.84: Karyo is built on a simple principle: active performance depends on delivery architecture. The value of an active is determined not only by what it is, but by how it is protected, combined, and delivered under real agricultural conditions.

techContent.86: Karyo is the delivery and protection layer of the Kriya stack. Unlike Wynn and Microvate, Karyo is not restricted to microbial systems. It is built for both microbial and botanical actives and can support encapsulated single-actives, multi-actives, and hybrid combinations within structured agricultural delivery systems. Karyo focuses on how sensitive actives are protected, combined, and translated into usable field-facing product architectures.

techContent.107: Microvate is Kriya's precision activation platform for microbial systems that are designed to remain protected during storage and become functionally ready only at the point of use. It separates storage stability from biological readiness through a controlled activation architecture.
techContent.108: Microvate is built on a powerful principle: stability and activation should not be forced to happen in the same state. By separating protected storage from activation readiness, the platform creates a more controlled transition from biological preservation to biological performance.

It is built around a dual-component logic in which the microbial active remains protected during storage while an activation-support system remains separate until needed. Microvate does not focus on microbial discovery and does not replace Karyo's broader delivery role. Its function is to control when and how the microbial system becomes ready.

productContent.16: Admira Admon is a plant-based botanical bio-insecticide formulated with cinnamon oil extracted from Cinnamomum species. It contains naturally occurring compounds such as cinnamaldehyde, which provide strong insecticidal, repellent, and antimicrobial properties. Admira Admon works primarily through contact and fumigant action, disrupting pest activity and affecting their respiration and cellular functions. It is effective against a wide range of insect pests, mites, and certain fungal pathogens in agricultural and horticultural crops. Due to its natural origin, biodegradability, and low environmental impact, it is well suited for sustainable crop protection and Integrated Pest Management (IPM) programs.
productContent.17: Admira Adove is a plant-based botanical bio-insecticide formulated with clove oil extracted from Syzygium aromaticum. It contains naturally occurring compounds such as eugenol, known for their insecticidal, repellent, and antimicrobial properties. Admira Adove acts primarily through contact action, disrupting pest cell membranes and physiological processes. It is effective against a broad range of insect pests and mites in agricultural and horticultural crops. Due to its natural origin, biodegradability, and low environmental impact, it is suitable for sustainable crop protection and Integrated Pest Management (IPM) programs.
productContent.18: Admira Adrlic is a plant-based botanical bio-insecticide formulated with garlic oil extracted from Allium sativum. It contains naturally occurring sulfur compounds such as allicin, known for their insecticidal, repellent, and antimicrobial properties. Admira Adrlic works primarily through contact and repellent action, disrupting pest feeding and activity. It is effective against a wide range of insect pests and mites in agricultural and horticultural crops. Due to its natural origin, biodegradability, and low environmental impact, it supports sustainable crop protection and Integrated Pest Management (IPM) programs.
productContent.19: Admira Adyme is a plant-based botanical bio-insecticide formulated with thyme oil extracted from Thymus species. It contains naturally occurring compounds such as thymol, which provide strong insecticidal, antimicrobial, and repellent properties. It acts primarily through contact and fumigant action, disrupting pests and affecting their respiration and cellular functions. It is effective against a wide range of insect pests and mites in agricultural crops. Due to its natural origin, biodegradability, and low environmental impact, Admira Adyme is well suited for sustainable crop protection and Integrated Pest Management (IPM) programs.

productContent.49: Azadirachtin functions primarily as a feeding deterrent and insect growth regulator. It disrupts ecdysone- and juvenile-hormone-mediated endocrine signaling, interferes with molting and metamorphosis, suppresses larval feeding, and reduces fecundity, oviposition, and egg viability in exposed pest populations.
productContent.50: Azotobacter chroococcum colonizes the rhizosphere and non-symbiotically fixes atmospheric N2 into plant-available ammonia through nitrogenase enzyme activity. It also secretes plant growth-promoting substances including auxins, gibberellins, and vitamins that stimulate root development and shoot vigor.

productContent.53: Bacillus amyloliquefaciens colonizes the rhizosphere and phyllosphere and suppresses pathogens through biofilm formation, competitive exclusion, and release of antifungal and antibacterial secondary metabolites such as iturin-, fengycin-, and surfactin-like lipopeptides. This reduces pathogen establishment and can prime plant defense responses.
productContent.54: Bacillus aryabhattai secretes organic acids (gluconic and 2-keto-gluconic acid) that chelate and solubilize insoluble zinc compounds such as ZnO, ZnCO3, and Zn3(PO4)2. The released Zn2+ ions become available for root uptake, correcting the widespread zinc deficiency that limits yield across staple crops.
productContent.55: Bacillus megaterium secretes organic acids and phosphatase enzymes in the rhizosphere that solubilize fixed inorganic phosphates and mineralize organic phosphorus compounds. This releases plant-available orthophosphate ions, enhancing P uptake efficiency and reducing dependence on chemical phosphate fertilizers.
productContent.56: Bacillus mucilaginosus produces organic acids and polysaccharides that dissolve silicate minerals, releasing plant-available silicic acid. Absorbed silicon deposits in cell walls to reinforce structural integrity, reducing insect penetration, fungal infection, and lodging in cereals.
productContent.57: Bacillus subtilis colonizes plant surfaces and the rhizosphere, forms biofilms, and suppresses pathogens through lipopeptide antibiotics, lytic enzymes, and competitive exclusion. It also stimulates host defense responses, reducing establishment of both foliar and soil-borne disease organisms.
productContent.58: Beauveria bassiana conidia adhere to the insect cuticle, germinate, and penetrate through enzymatic degradation using proteases, chitinases, and lipases. The fungus colonizes the hemocoel, produces insecticidal secondary metabolites, and suppresses the pest through mycosis followed by external sporulation.
productContent.59: Best used within 12 months of manufacture. Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight.

productContent.61: Bioactive plant metabolites act as signaling and metabolic priming molecules that enhance enzyme activity, nutrient uptake pathways, and antioxidant defense systems. productContent.64: Zymor is a biological fungicide and plant growth–promoting bioagent based on the beneficial fungus Trichoderma asperellum. It works by colonizing the plant root zone and suppressing soil-borne fungal pathogens through mechanisms such as competition, mycoparasitism, and the production of antifungal metabolites. Zymor helps control diseases caused by pathogens like Fusarium, Rhizoctonia, Pythium, and Sclerotium. In addition to disease suppression, it enhances root development, improves nutrient uptake, and promotes overall plant vigor. It is widely used in sustainable agriculture and Integrated Disease Management (IDM) programs due to its environmental safety and compatibility with organic farming practices.
productContent.65: Zymor-H is a biological fungicide and plant growth–promoting bioagent based on the beneficial fungus Trichoderma harzianum. It colonizes the plant rhizosphere and suppresses soil-borne plant pathogens through mechanisms such as competition, mycoparasitism, and the production of antifungal metabolites. Zymor-H helps manage diseases caused by pathogens like Fusarium, Pythium, Rhizoctonia, and Sclerotium. In addition to disease control, it enhances root growth, improves nutrient availability, and promotes overall plant health and vigor. It is widely used in sustainable agriculture, Integrated Disease Management (IDM), and organic farming systems.
productContent.66: Blooma is a natural biostimulant derived from Ascophyllum nodosum seaweed extract. It is formulated to enhance plant growth, root development, and stress tolerance through the action of naturally occurring phytohormones such as cytokinins, auxins, and gibberellins. Blooma promotes healthier, more productive crops by improving nutrient uptake, stimulating enzymatic activity, and supporting balanced plant physiology.
